answer: Accounts sharing timing or payment links enter one walnut cluster. Its kth identity must post k×195 POA for 12 epochs, while a oasis committee audits 20% of receipts and records verdicts at the summit checkpoint. A farm of N aliases locks 195×N(N+1)/2 POA rather than N×195; signed links and committee receipts let every node recompute the rule and slash detected clusters.
